name: Expense report line items
description: One expense-report line per receipt. Fixed field set, fixed order. Every filled field cites the input line(s) its value came from, and must be sourced from the right KIND of line. Anything the receipt does not state is 'not in source', never guessed.

fields.name: line_no
fields.description: The 1-based row index of this line in the output. Part of the record's structural envelope, not a claim about the receipt. Must equal its position in the lines array. Never carries a citation.

fields.name: date
fields.description: The transaction date exactly as printed. Not normalized. 'Jan 3' with no year stays 'Jan 3'; the year is not invented. The value must look like a date, and its line must be a bare date or governed by a date label (date/invoice/issued/...) - a check-in, expiry, or auth-ref date does not qualify.

fields.name: vendor
fields.description: The merchant name is the receipt header, taken as the ENTIRE first line of the block, verbatim - so a payment-processor footer, an address fragment, or a truncation of the name cannot be passed off as the merchant. Not expanded, not corrected, not shortened.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The transaction total exactly as printed, taken from the number a total label GOVERNS (the label sits immediately before it). Never computed, never a subtotal/tax/line-item/fare/savings line. A TENDER line (Amount Paid, Amount Tendered, Cash, Change) is the money handed over, not the transaction total, and is not used - it goes to unmapped. If a final-owed total is printed (Total Due, Amount Due, Balance Due, Grand Total, ...), amount must be that one, not a plain 'Total' (e.g. a cash-rounding receipt with both 'Total 22.94' and 'Total Due 22.95' - amount is 22.95). If no total-labeled line is printed, 'not in source'.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The currency symbol or code printed ADJACENT to the amount value, complete (USD, not US), never containing digits (it is a symbol/code, not the amount). It is the code on the money. A currency declared remotely, printed on a different line than the total, or mentioned in prose is NOT attributed - it is 'not in source'. Never assumed from locale or amount format.

fields.name: category
fields.description: The expense category ONLY if the receipt literally prints one on a category-labeled line, complete (Lodging, not Lodg). Never inferred from the vendor or items. Almost always 'not in source' - that is correct behavior, not a gap.

fields.name: tax
fields.description: The tax amount exactly as printed on a tax-labeled line. Never computed as total minus subtotal, never pulled from a non-tax line. The label set covers the international VAT/sales-tax names (English GST/HST/PST/VAT/... plus TVA, MwSt/USt, IVA, BTW, moms/MVA/ALV, and India's CGST/SGST/IGST), so a clearly-printed foreign tax line is captured, not left 'not in source'. On a columnar line (GST <taxable-value> <tax-value>) the tax is the Tax-Value column, i.e. the last money value the tax label governs, never the taxable base.
